Miles on the Go

Download the Etihad Guest app to earn 1 Etihad Guest Mile and 1 Tier Mile for every AED 3 you spend across Etihad Guest “miles on the go” partners when you link ADIB Etihad Guest Visa cards and spend using the linked card. Want to pay with miles? Turn on your app notifications.
Complimentary Companion Ticket

Spend AED 150,000 in a calendar year and earn a complimentary companion ticket on any Etihad Airways flight. Your companion can travel in any cabin class Economy, Business, or First on any Etihad route worldwide.

Your 35,000 welcome miles cover the equivalent of multiple return Economy flights from Abu Dhabi - giving you a head start on both miles and tier progress from day one. Every Etihad flight brings you closer to Silver, and your Companion Ticket gives you someone to fly with along the way.
